# How Cushion works

Cushion is fee-free overdraft coverage for debit card purchases, available on Plus and Premium.

## How much it covers

- Plus: up to $50.00
- Premium: up to $200
- Basic: not available

## Who can use it

You need at least $500 in direct deposits in the last 30 days. Turn it on in the app under Profile, then Cushion.

## What it covers

Debit card purchases only, including mobile wallet payments. It never covers ATM withdrawals, transfers, BrookPay, wires or plan fees.

## What it costs

Nothing. Cushion has no fees ($0.00) and no interest.

## Paying it back

Your next deposit repays it automatically. If your balance stays negative for 30 days, Cushion is suspended. See "Repaying Cushion".

## Turning it off

You can switch Cushion off at any time in the same place. Purchases larger than your balance are then declined, with no fee.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.
</document>
